in_tamil.name: ஜோஷினீ

in_telugu.name: జోశినీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: జోశ్ (Josh) చేరయోపధియోదేశ (cherayopadhivOdesa) ఇనీ (Nee) - The one who is the embodiment of the grace and blessings of Lord Vishnu

in_marathi.name: Joshini
in_marathi.long_meaning: Joshini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Joshini is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Josh'. It translates to 'graceful' or 'pure'. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge, learning, and music. Joshini is believed to bring wisdom and creativity to those who bear the name.
